name: Heart-Healthy Diet
description: Limits sodium, saturated fat, and trans fat, and asks for enough fruit and vegetables. Example limits for learning; confirm with a registered dietitian.

rules.message: Total sodium for the day must not go over 2,000 mg.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Sodium intake for adults and children (2012)

rules.message: Saturated fat must give less than 10% of the day's calories.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Saturated fatty acid and trans-fatty acid intake (2023)

rules.message: Trans fat must give less than 1% of the day's calories.
rules.source: WHO guideline: Saturated fatty acid and trans-fatty acid intake (2023)

rules.message: Eat at least 5 servings of fruit and vegetables a day (1 serving is about 80 g).
rules.source: WHO: at least 400 g of fruit and vegetables per day

rules.message: Avoid deep-fried foods and cured meats.
